test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Pull yourself together

options.text: Calm down after an upsetting incident

solution:
The correct answer is "**Calm down after an upsetting incident**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom "Pull yourself together" refers to **Calm down after an upsetting incident**.
 
• It is used to describe a situation where **one motivates the other to calm down and move forward positively**.
 
 
• **Example**- Just pull yourself together, there's no point crying about it.
 
• **Example**- After hearing the bad news I needed a few minutes to pull myself together.
 
 

Therefore, the correct option is "**Option 3".**
